# @dxtmisha/figma-translate

> Figma plugin for automated design text translation, codegen localization, and i18n extraction.

Enables batch extraction of text layers from Figma designs, multi-language translation management, and export into design system localization keys.

## Key Modules & Files

- [manifest.json](manifest.json): Figma plugin manifest defining codegen and inspect capabilities.
- [code.ts](src/code.ts): Backend sandbox script for finding, reading, and updating text nodes.
- [App.vue](src/App.vue): Plugin user interface for language selection, translation preview, and batch processing.
- [classes](src/classes): Translation models and localization token builders.

## Optional

- [package.json](package.json): Scripts for building dual-target Figma plugin bundles.
